subject: Self-serve credit activation timeout / manual issuance request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@novascalelabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Free credits not showing after signup (RDW-PLG-100)

Hi Jasmine,

We just signed up a couple of engineers (team@nslabs.com) and tried to apply the RDW-PLG-100 promo during signup, but the dashboard shows a zero credit balance. The signup flow completed and we received the confirmation email, but there's no promo in the wallet.

Can you check whether the promo applied on your side? We need the credits to run a first internal test this afternoon. If there's any info you need (account id, sign-up email), let me know.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Developer Experience
NovaScale Labs
[Attachment: signup_confirmation_20270921.eml]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam@novascalelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Free credits not showing after signup (RDW-PLG-100)

Hi Liam — sorry for the trouble and thanks for the details.

Quick checklist so we can triage fast:
- Can you confirm the signup email (team@nslabs.com looks right from the confirmation) and the account id if you have it?
- Did the confirmation email show a coupon code applied in the body or was it absent?

I’ve looped in Ben from billing to check logs and Laura from growth in case this is a promo-rule mismatch. If the self-serve flow failed we can manually grant the credits and consider a brief trial extension.

I’ll update you within the hour.

— Jasmine
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connell <liam@novascalelabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Free credits not showing after signup (RDW-PLG-100)

On Tue, Sep 21, 2027 at 9:28 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ve looped in Ben from billing to check logs and Laura from growth in case this is a promo-rule mismatch.

Hi all — dug into the issuance logs for account team@nslabs.com. Summary: the promo redemption request hit our promo-service but the downstream issuance webhook to the wallet timed out (error: 523-WEBHOOK-ETIMEOUT) and the issuance was never persisted. I attached the short CSV extract of the claim attempts.

What I see in redwood_claim_log_20270921.csv (rows shown):
- 2027-09-21T16:41:12Z, acc_98765, RDW-PLG-100, CLAIM_PENDING, webhook_timeout
- 2027-09-21T16:41:46Z, acc_98765, RDW-PLG-100, CLAIM_FAILED, webhook_timeout

Next steps I can take immediately:
- Manual grant 100 credit units to acc_98765 (will generate a manual_grant_receipt_20270921.pdf).
- Add a 30-day trial extension as a courtesy.
- Open a ticket with infra to trace the webhook latency and add a compensating retry so future claims retry automatically.

Liam — please confirm you want the manual grant + extension and I’ll process it now. ETA for the manual grant to reflect in the UI is ~10–15 minutes once I apply it.

— Ben
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_claim_log_20270921.csv]
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@novascalelabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novascalelabs.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Free credits not showing after signup (RDW-PLG-100)

Thanks Ben — yes please go ahead with the manual grant and add the 30-day trial extension. We have engineers scheduled to kick the tires at 14:00 PT so the faster the better.

For our records, please include the grant amount and the new trial expiry in the receipt.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Liam
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam@novascalelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Credits applied — confirmation and follow-up

Liam — confirmed: Ben applied 100 credit units to acc_98765 and added a 30-day trial extension. You should now see a balance of 100 credits in the wallet and the trial expiry updated to 2027-10-21.

Manual receipt: manual_grant_receipt_20270921.pdf (attached). If the team still sees a zero balance after a hard refresh, please send a screenshot and we’ll escalate to infra immediately.

Action items for us internally:
- Ben: follow up with infra (ticket INFRA-7093) to add a retry window for promo webhooks.
- Laura: review promo rule logs to ensure RDW-PLG-100 is still active for PLG signups.

Thanks for the patience — let me know if you want me to schedule a quick check-in with your engineers this afternoon.

— Jasmine
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: manual_grant_receipt_20270921.pdf]
